home.q: How much does a project cost?
home.a: Every project is different. After a short discovery call we send a fixed, itemised quote, so you know the full cost before any work starts.

home.q: How long does it take to build?
home.a: A focused MVP usually takes 6 to 12 weeks. Larger platforms are delivered in phases, with a working release every few weeks so you see progress early.

home.q: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
home.a: Yes. We help founders launch their first product and help established companies modernise, automate and secure the systems they already run.

home.q: Who owns the code and intellectual property?
home.a: You do. All code, designs and documentation are transferred to you, and we can sign an NDA before we start.

home.q: Do you offer support after launch?
home.a: Yes. We offer monitoring, maintenance, security updates and new features on a monthly retainer, or on demand.

contact.a: Yes. We are happy to sign your NDA, or send ours, before you share any details.
Absolutely. Many clients start with a paid discovery sprint or a small pilot before committing to a full build.

software-engineering.q: Can you work with our existing codebase?
software-engineering.a: Yes. We start with a short code audit, then improve and extend what you have instead of rewriting for the sake of it.

software-engineering.q: Which tech stack will you use?
software-engineering.a: The one that fits your problem and team. We often use Laravel, Node.js or Python with PostgreSQL, and we explain every choice.
Yes. Everything lives in your repository from day one, and all IP is transferred to you.

web-development.q: How long does a website take?
web-development.a: A marketing site usually takes 4 to 8 weeks. Web applications are scoped individually and delivered in phases.

web-development.q: Will we be able to edit the content ourselves?
web-development.a: Yes. We set up a CMS or admin panel and train your team, so updates never need a developer.
Yes. Technical SEO, page speed, structured data and analytics are part of every build.

app-development.a: For most products a cross-platform app is faster and cheaper. We recommend native only when performance or device features require it.

app-development.q: Do you handle App Store approval?
app-development.a: Yes. We prepare listings, screenshots and builds, and manage submission and review for both stores.
We monitor crashes and usage, fix issues quickly and ship improvements on a regular schedule.

ai-computer-vision.q: How much data do we need to start?
ai-computer-vision.a: Often less than you think. We can start from a small labelled sample and grow the dataset as the system runs.

ai-computer-vision.q: Can it run on our own servers?
ai-computer-vision.a: Yes. We deploy to your cloud, your on-premise servers or edge devices, depending on your privacy and latency needs.
We agree on target metrics with you up front, test on your real data, and monitor accuracy in production with alerts if it drifts.

automation-engineering.a: Anything rule-based and repetitive: data entry, report downloads, portal submissions, reconciliations and notifications are common examples.

automation-engineering.q: What if a website we automate changes?
automation-engineering.a: Bots are monitored. If a run fails we are alerted, and fixes are covered by our support plans.
Yes. Credentials are stored encrypted, access is limited to what each bot needs, and every action is logged.

mobile-automation.q: Do you use emulators or real phones?
mobile-automation.a: Both. Real devices give the most reliable results, and we use emulators where they are good enough to save cost.

mobile-automation.q: How many devices can you run at once?
mobile-automation.a: It scales with hardware. We design the orchestration so adding devices does not mean rewriting flows.

mobile-automation.q: Can we see what the devices are doing?
mobile-automation.a: Yes. The dashboard shows live status, and every run stores screenshots and logs.

api-integration.q: Can you integrate a tool without a public API?
api-integration.a: Often, yes. We use exports, webhooks or carefully built automation when no API exists.

api-integration.q: What happens when a partner API is down?
api-integration.a: Requests are queued and retried automatically, and you are alerted if a problem persists.

api-integration.q: Do you document the APIs you build?
api-integration.a: Yes. Every API ships with OpenAPI documentation and example requests.

data-engineering.a: We only collect publicly available data, respect site terms and robots rules, and follow data protection law.

data-engineering.q: How fresh will the data be?
data-engineering.a: As fresh as you need: from real-time streams to hourly or daily batches, depending on sources and cost.

data-engineering.q: Can you work with our existing database?
data-engineering.a: Yes. We can build on your current database or warehouse rather than replacing it.

quality-engineering.q: Can you test software you didn't build?
quality-engineering.a: Yes. We regularly add test automation to existing products and teams.

quality-engineering.q: Will tests slow down our releases?
quality-engineering.a: No. Fast suites run on every change, and longer suites run in parallel or on a schedule.

quality-engineering.q: Do you do manual testing too?
quality-engineering.a: Yes, for exploratory and usability testing, alongside automation for everything repeatable.

devops-cloud.q: Can you migrate us to the cloud without downtime?
devops-cloud.a: In most cases, yes. We plan migrations in stages with rollback options at every step.

devops-cloud.q: Which cloud provider should we use?
devops-cloud.a: It depends on your team, compliance needs and budget. We compare options honestly before recommending one.

devops-cloud.q: Will DevOps lower our cloud bill?
devops-cloud.a: Usually. Right-sizing, autoscaling and cleaning up unused resources often cut costs noticeably.

cyber-security.q: Is penetration testing safe for our live systems?
cyber-security.a: Yes. Testing is authorised in writing, scoped carefully and scheduled to avoid disruption.

cyber-security.q: What do we get at the end?
cyber-security.a: A clear report with risk ratings, evidence and fixes, plus a retest once fixes are in.

cyber-security.q: Can you help us meet compliance requirements?
cyber-security.a: Yes. We help put controls and evidence in place for standards like ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR.
